recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-39068. Consider FHIR-54097 separately if that later PA decision enters an applied/published reconciliation scope.
issue_request: FHIR-39068 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction asking PA to make Encounter.admission.reAdmission's brief definition and overlong short display follow the usual element wording pattern. The voted resolution set the definition to explain that the encounter is directly related to a prior admission and set the short display to indicate that a patient is being re-admitted.
initial_application: Commit 75483ba57e4cc762d66677b28c43a0934d7682f9, merged by PR #2580 as 8595fc8f21e8971d757a161b4233feb21de87da0, applied FHIR-39068 to source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml by replacing the old readmission short/definition pair with the expanded definition and concise short display.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists encounter=Encounter in the active [resources] section, confirming the inspected Encounter StructureDefinition source is in build scope. Current source and the combined branch retain the approved definition. The short display says "Indicates that the patient is being re-admitted" rather than Jira's "Indicates that a patient is being re-admitted.", but that article and punctuation difference does not change implementer understanding. Later related FHIR-54097 is only Resolved - change required and requests a separate comment about why reAdmission is a CodeableConcept rather than a boolean.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current active source already conveys FHIR-39068's semantic correction and the only mismatch from the Jira resolution is cosmetic.
